reviews.title: WORST EVER!
reviews.text: They cancelled my flight without previous notice. They gave a hoot on how I would catch my connecting flight and to top it all off, they have not refunded my money qnd they mock me every time I call for my refund. Even the so called president mocks me. My recommendation to you, choose a different airline.
reviews.author: Reyna L

reviews.title: Short flight right on schedule
reviews.text: No need to get to the airport more than 45min-1 hour early. They will not check you in early. The flight was on time and a great way to get to and from Cozumel from Cancun.
reviews.author: Jen J

reviews.title: Mayair
reviews.text: Nice short flight from Cozumel to Cancun as our return flight left from there. Much better than taking the ferry to Playa and then a shuttle to Cancun. Will certainly do it again if flight from Cozumel is not available.
reviews.author: Diann L

reviews.title: First time on Mayair
reviews.text: We live in Calgary, Canada, so getting to Cozumel means flying through Toronto (yuk) or Houston. We have lots of direct flights to Cancun, so we booked with Mayair to jump over to Cozumel. The cost was ~ $US 63 pp one way, which is not bad, but watch out for the excess baggage fees. As I am a diver, I pack all my dive equipment. The excess baggage fee was $87 (one way), so the return flights for 2 got quite expensive. More important is the time it takes to get from the Cancun airport to the Mayair (FBO) airport. DO NOT take the free shuttle unless you have LOTS of time. We arrived in Cancun at 4:30pm and had a 7pm flight with Mayair (seems like lots of time right), NOPE, it took a long time to get through customs, even longer time to get our bags, then we had to wait for the free shuttle, which was going to take us to Terminal 2, then we'd have to take another shuttle to FBO. When we were walking to the first shuttle, a local worker strongly recommended we take a cab ($20), and thank goodness we did. By the time the cab drove us to FBO in heavy traffic, we arrived at FBO in the nick of time. Had we taken the shuttle, we would have missed that plane, and had to stay over in Cancun. Recommendation - take a cab from the main Cancun International airport to FBO just to be safe.
reviews.author: Ward C

reviews.title: Flight canceled and no refund
reviews.text: Purchased a round-trip flight from Cancun to Cozumel. The staff were very friendly and flight to Cozumel went well, but the flight back to Cancun was canceled. They attempted to content me in advance of the flight, but they had a wrong email address. At the airport I talked with Mayair, and they said to send them an email asking for a refund. I did that, and sent a follow up email, but there's been no response. I ended up taking the ferry instead, and contacted my credit card company which refunded my payment.
reviews.author: steve

reviews.title: BE VERY AWARE OF MAYAIR – CANCELLED FLIGHT – WILL NOT REFUND
reviews.text: I’ve got the same story as others – our flight from Cozumel to Cancun was cancelled November 2019 and no alternative flight was offered. We didn’t find out until the morning we were about to fly out, so we scrambled to get the ferry to the Cancun airport in order to catch 2 more connecting flights home. I tried desperately to get a refund from MAYAir. I sent 6 emails and had 4 conversations with 2 different people. I followed up each conversation with an email to track everything. MAYAir just kept putting me off. At one point, one of these people actually hung up on me, when I was just saying ‘hello, my name is…’. Their website states they give refunds, but I don’t believe they had any intention of refunding our money. However, I called CIBC Visa (our credit card bank), and they refunded the amount owing on our credit card. If you find yourself in this situation, call your credit card bank and dispute the charge. It’s an invalid charge on your Statement, because you never received the service.
reviews.author: Bonnie J

reviews.title: No flight, money gone
reviews.text: I am writing my first ever TripAdvisor review because I am very disappointed and angry about my experience with Mayair. The same story. Arrived at the airport. No plane. In fact no plane for a couple of days. No rebooking to another airline, no other options than reusing my Mayair ticket whenever a new plane pops out. The only thing they could provide was a direction to a desk of another airline, with your own cost. Later I sent an email to the airline, asking my money back. Never got a response.
reviews.author: CaribbeanTraveler79

reviews.title: This airline is a fraud
reviews.text: MayAir has cancelled our flight from Villahermosa to Merida about 8 hours before departure via email. We were travelling and had no chance to read emails, so we found out at the airport. They didn't offer anything: another flight or any help to get to our destination (next day's flight was cancelled, too). They didn't care at all. Luckily we got a connection flight via Mexico City with Aeromexico, for the double price though. The MayAir employee at the counter claimed we would get our money back, but this still hasn't happened, weeks later. To summarize: no flight, no money, no customer care. This airline is a fraud and only book with them if you are okay with the high probability that your flight will be cancelled, you will lose your money and will potentially have to pay for an expensive additional ticket to reach your destination.
reviews.author: Unelma333

reviews.title: Same story - cancelled flight and no refund
reviews.text: My wife and I flew this airline last year and it was awesome. Last year, they had flights at 8 PM that would allow us to fly to CZM after the last United flight of the night that came in at 7 PM. It was so fast and convenient. Well not only have they removed the 8PM flight, apparently they just don't fly anymore. We had booked the 11 AM flight on Tuesday 11/5 after arriving in CUN 11/4 at 7PM. We were advised via email initially that our flight was changed to 1PM...not a big deal, kind of disappointed but at least we could sleep in and eat breakfast and be lazy for a bit longer. Then at 10 PM 11/4, another email was sent while we were sleeping stating our flight was cancelled. No other travel options were presented...just "sorry". Monetarily, two options were presented - a refund or keep the flight credit for a year. I requested a refund - TWICE. As of 11/11 nothing has been refunded to my credit card and I am disputing this transaction with Chase. Had we known our flight was going to be cancelled, we would have been up early to catch the first ADO bus and then the first ferry bus to Cozumel and not wasted half a day thinking our flight was only delayed. Will not be using this airline again unless the reviews here start showing they actually fly people to their destination and not steal their money.
reviews.author: minter66

reviews.title: Bad service
reviews.text: I am repeating the same review of another person that has had the same experience We opted to take Mayair from Cancun to Cozumel since it sounded pretty cheap and easy, we were landing at 1230pm and the flight was at 230pm.They claimed to send an e-mail which I never received from Karina Estevez vuelos2@mayair.com.mx that our flight was cancelled: not just our flight but all flights in the midafternoon. It wasn't practical for us to wait until 7pm to get to our resort so we decided to get a cab instead and go to the ferry She said we could get a refund. After a week of not hearing anything I emailed again and she said to be patient and that it takes time to process. From then on we never heard back, calling the day before and a couple times after: no response. Currently calling trying to resolve this, nothing so far. Poor customer service that's no way to run a airline.
reviews.author: woodrun26

reviews.title: Cancelled flights and no resolution
reviews.text: We opted to take Mayair from Cancun to Cozumel since it sounded pretty cheap and easy, we were landing at 1230pm and the flight was at 230pm. A few weeks before we got an email from Karina Estevez vuelos2@mayair.com.mx that our flight was cancelled: not just our flight but all flights in the midafternoon. It wasn't practical for us to wait until 7pm to get to our resort so we decided to get a cab instead and asked if we could get a refund. After a week of not hearing anything I emailed again and she said to be patient and that it takes time to process. From then on we never heard back, emailing the day before and a couple times after: no response. Currently emailing the website and trying to resolve this, nothing so far. Poor customer service and probably a failing airline if they have to indefinitely cancel one of their main daily mid-day flights.
reviews.author: Brandon B

reviews.title: Quick and easy to Cozumel
reviews.text: We booked our flight several months before our trip and noted that there were not many flights and few seats. The Mayair gate is at the FBO terminal. It is NOT attached to the main Cancun terminal although the airport map shows that it is. There is supposed to be a shuttle every half hour but to be sure we took a $15 cab ride which took about 10 minutes. We arrived at the 2 hour check in time but they said that they don't start checking you in before 1 hour to go...the same thing happened in Cozumel. The Mayair gate was in the main terminal at Cozumel but be alert...the gate number is not posted. We flew from gate no. 1...there are 6 of them and all are within sight of each other but if there is another big plane boarding you may not see the Mayair folks walking you to the plane. The flight is about 20 minutes.
reviews.author: Burg411

reviews.title: Good flight but . . .
reviews.text: My flight from Cozumel to Cancun was just fine - everything went smoothly - except the directions said to get to the airport two hours before the flight. Being quite compliant, I showed up as expected and asked where I should go. I was told that there would be no one there to check us in until one hour before the flight. (I could have used that extra time.) 🙄
reviews.author: Suzanne L

reviews.title: This airline might be small but they are good
reviews.text: The flight from Villahermosa to Merida was only an hour but in this time the hostess had msanaged to serve drinks and nibbles to all the passengers on board. Flight uneventful but very much on time
reviews.author: Cornakey

reviews.title: Buyer Beware
reviews.text: Very Important!! Read the disclosure for total weight before you book your flight. The maximum per person is 44# all in. We needed to get from Cozumel to Cancun after a dive trip. Our dive gear alone exceeded their limits. We found out about this limitation at the gate. $360 later this weight limit was pointed out to us in the second sentence of the sixth paragraph on the second page of the flight confirmation printout. I should have taken the ferry and drove.
reviews.author: dietwithaz

reviews.title: A lovely flight from Merida to Cancun
reviews.text: Our flight was part of our voyage across Mexico, which is a country well worth visiting by the way. Mayair is a Mexican airline operating on internal routes, with a fleet of aircraft ranging from 5 - 50 seaters. We were away for a month and the 3 of us had a fair amount of luggage, most of which had to be checked for this flight in a Dornier 228. The check-in staff were excellent, taking a pragmatic view to our luggage and we were quickly checked in and onto the delightful turbo-prop plane with 12 other passengers. The stewardess welcomed us aboard, checked our seat belts and then got off and shut the door! Our flight was bang on time and a delightful across Mexico's beautiful Yucatan peninsula ensued, featuring our flying over Chichen Itza, which the pilot circled so we all got a good view! We touched down in Cancun on time and the baggage almost beat us to the terminal! All in all a cracking airline with great staff. Don't read much into the marked ratings below, you really can't compare Mayair with your average airline.
reviews.author: David H

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Flight was 2 hrs late for a 30 minute flight. We waited in airport while they manually checked in passengers. Wish we would have taken the ferry!
reviews.author: MonicaNikki

reviews.title: Left me in Cancuan
reviews.text: Arrived at the ticket counter 20 minutes before the 1:00 pm departure. Sign at desk said we will be right back. 10 minutes later a girl shows up and says sorry plane just left. So your plane left early and leaves me here. Yes, all I can do is book you on the 4:00pm flight and Charge you a change fee. No refund offered either. Will not use this airline again. Had to take a taxi to Plays del Carmen and then a ferry to get to Cozumel.
reviews.author: Jon F

reviews.title: What a great airline
reviews.text: This airline is just brilliant if only all the big guys still offered this level of service. They were perfectly on time and really friendly
reviews.author: Ralph C

reviews.title: Oustanding service
reviews.text: This is a new airline with small planes. Still, I think that their service was outstanding and they offer a wonderful, economically accessible option. Yes, their plains are small, they can get hot, but their flights are not=rmally short and their customer service is among the best of the best. Simply outstanding.
reviews.author: DorisV660

reviews.title: Great way to travel from Cancun to Cozumel
reviews.text: Fun flight with exceptional customer service, they also had a free shuttle from the private terminal to the main terminal at Cancun Airport. Most efficient means of travel between Cozumel and Cancun and the prices were modest.
reviews.author: Thomas G

reviews.title: Small planes....  read details
reviews.text: Flight was good- short enough to not be much of a problem! Because it is a small plane, the AC sucks!! So it’s hot as he!! In that little plane!! So if it’s hot and humid, and you don’t like flying (which my business partner did not) it was barf bag time! Also- their weight limits are WAY less than standard airlines so the additional weight fees were outrageous!! Just be warned!!
reviews.author: Heather w

reviews.title: Good route to Cozumel
reviews.text: Mayair is a great option to get to Cozumel. We flew from Mexico City to Cancun then did the Cancun-Cozumel hop with Mayair. The only challenge is the airport transit bus between the terminals which can take AGES! It is supposed to run every 20 mins or so but wasn't the day we landed. You need to go to the FBO terminal and from the main domestic and international terminals this can take a while- give yourself 2 hours between flights. The bus drivers are helpful and let you know where to get off. The flight checking was easy and the flight was quick and easy.
reviews.author: Sarah H

reviews.title: 6 passenger plane adventure
reviews.text: Gate and flight team were friendly and helpful. Pilot was exceptional, the wind was howling and he got us to calm air as smoothly and quickly as possible. This was the first trip on a small plane for my wife and daughter and they were nervous at first but the beautiful scenery and pilot getting us to smooth aire quickly calmed them and they enjoyed it tremendously. Would do it again.
reviews.author: TxKev

reviews.title: Nice service but do not arrive too early!!
reviews.text: Mayair service is perfectly fine and comfortable for the short flight over to Cozumel. The views of the water below are amazing!! However two warnings. One, you cannot checkin more than an hour before departure. Second don't arrive much before that because the FBO Terminal they operate from in CUN has NO amenities at all. No restaurant, snack bar, bar, no nothing. If you have a long connect at Cancun sped some time snacking and drinking there. There was a cool-looking outdoor cantina in terminal three, I think. Enjoy your trip!
reviews.author: Bill O

reviews.title: Poor Customer Service
reviews.text: Just got back from one of my 2x a year trips to beautiful Cozumel. I flew into Cancun on Southwest Airlines to save a few dollars vs a direct flight into Cozumel. I have done this for many years and I am willing to put up with the small amount of stress considering the Mayair terminal is a 15 minute shuttle ride from the main terminal. This last trip was the worst. My Mayair flight was scheduled at 1:00PM. I arrived to the terminal at 12:40PM. 20 minutes to spare, right? No...The problem was Mayair decided to load the plane early. I actually was talking with my buddy that arrived earlier on another flight and saved me a place in line. Mayair would then not let me board the plane. There was nobody at the counter to help check me in which aggrivated the situation. When I did track someone down he said he would check it I could board with the rest of the passengers that where in the process of boarding. He walked towards the plane and took a left hand turn right into the bathroom. He spent 5 minutes taking care of his personal business and finally came out and avoided me as he started chatting with his buddies. By the time anyone would acknowledge me as a paying customer with a problem it was too late. The planes’s engines had started and they where on their way. Mayair is a great alternative if you are a local but if you are a foreign tourist like myself be prepared to be ignored if you have an issue or problem. Oh yes, be prepared to pay extra fees on your luggage (carry on or checked) for going over your 21 KG allowance. By the way, they also charged me $25 to change tickets and wait another 3 hours for the next flight. I don’t usually don’t like to complain and look for the best in companies and people. I will be the first to admit if I make a mistake and cause an issue. I have no problem with paying extra fees for special considerations. But when customer service is NON-EXISTANT with no one available to help, then I have a problem.
reviews.author: srace2018

reviews.title: Saved time
reviews.text: We took a Mayair flight from Cancun to Cozumel. It saved us a ton of time versus doing the bag drag. There are no assigned seats, so choose the lowest price available. Don’t be alarmed when fog fills the cabin at takeoff, it’s the air conditioning.
reviews.author: Vickimc

reviews.title: Fantastic short haul airline
reviews.text: My very pregnant wife and I were heading to Cozumel to have a baby-moon, but could only get our outgoing leg of our flight from CZM. We had to fly into CUN to kick off the vacation. I’ve done the bus/walk/ferry dance before and really didn’t want to do it again. We landed at CUN, talked to a Lomas rep who phoned Mayair for us to confirm that there were seats still for sale on the aircraft. Turns out buying locally in pesos is cheaper than online with a USD credit card. We had to wait on purchasing our tickets because we were coming in so late and didn’t know if we would clear customs in time to catch their 8:30p flight (last of the day) No baggage fees are great, unless you have overweight bags. It was fast, comfortable and I am a huge aviation enthusiast so flying on a Dornier 228 was a treat, though I wish I could have flown I their Cessna 402 All in all this is a MUCH faster and easier way to reach the island than the bus and ferry. And arguable safer too!
reviews.author: minter66

reviews.title: Quick flight from Cancun to Cozumel & back - Service great, 4 seater plane - be prepared!
reviews.text: So on our latest visit to Cozumel, we decided to fly straight into Cancun and then take a flight with MayAir from Cancun to Cozumel (Same for flight back home). Be mindful of what time your MayAir flight leaves - stay in Cancun terminal until around 1 hour before, then take Lomas Travel over to the FBO terminal (FBO doesn't have any bars or food areas). We didn't realize when their mid size plane (seats 20) becomes full, the remainder of customers will fly on the smaller 4 seat plane. Ok...this plane was tiny. I feel I am the most calm person on a plan flight no matter what size plane, but even I was a bit nervous flying on such a small aircraft. My husband sat in front with the pilot and 3 others of us sat in the back. The flight actually wasn't too bad, just a few areas where it was a bit bumpy with turbulence. Great views of the beautiful water as we flew over - took about 20 minutes total on both flights. The larger aircraft on our way back from Cozumel to Cancun I felt a bit more secure. All-in-all, the terminal for MayAir was very modern and efficient - staff very nice, luggage handled quickly, transport from Terminal 4 to FBO terminal & on way back from FBO to Term 4 was smooth, the pricing very good - it was a good experience, I would fly again with them.
reviews.author: caribbeantravelcielo

reviews.title: Awesome service
reviews.text: Nice alternative to ferry bag drag. Flew on a 8 passenger plane. Great views leaving Cozumel. I believe there is a 45lb bag limit. That being said, my wife’s bag is always over 50 lbs, they added up our group of four weight and divided by four. No excess fees. Great customer service
reviews.author: Ycoz

reviews.title: Good quick flight to Cancun!
reviews.text: Forget the ferry! The flight with MayAir from Cozumel over to Cancun is convenient and reasonably priced. We left on time and landed a bit early. Planes are small but everyone gets a window seat. The views are amazing as the plane doesn't get to a very high altitude. Humidity does build up as you depart and the cabin fills with steam.....it is a little disconcerting if you don't know what it is.
reviews.author: Margaret A

reviews.title: Small Airline low baggage
reviews.text: A own small terminal, FBO in Cancun int. Airport, airportshuttel will bring you there every 20 min. smal 2propeller aircraft with less than 20 seats and max luggage of 20 kg checkin and 5 kg handluggage allowed. but interesting to see the pilots handling in their cokpit. It was a noisy adventure, starting flying deep over the coastline and landing.
reviews.author: marcsmaris

reviews.title: Great inter-Mexico travel option
reviews.text: I used Mayair for a flight from Cancun to Cozumel. This was my first time flying with them, and I would happily use them again in the future. I had several questions while trying to book my flight. They were quick to respond, and helpful with information. Our international flight was delayed, causing us to miss the original flight we booked, but they were very helpful in getting us onto the next flight. The flight between Cancun and Cozumel is VERY short, maybe 20 minutes, and it is a lower altitude flight. Despite being a smaller plane, I felt safe the entire time, and really enjoyed the views from the plane.
reviews.author: SoCalQTPie
